content_sections.heading: SCTIMST Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.information: Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology, Trivandrum (Bio Medical Technology Wing)

content_sections.heading: About SCTIMST
content_sections.text: SCTIMST, Trivandrum, is an Institution of National Importance under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India. This post sits in its Bio Medical Technology Wing at Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram. The project is "Development and evaluation of batch production system for making micro-needle array patches for trans-dermal drug delivery" (P.8261), and DST funds it.

content_sections.heading: SCTIMST Project Assistant Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The Project Assistant will work on the fabrication and characterization of polymeric microneedles. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: SCTIMST Project Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 50 years as on 1 October 2026. Essential: B.Sc Chemistry / Physics Wherever the notice asks for experience, it means experience gained after earning the prescribed essential qualification. EWS candidates need a valid Income and Asset certificate in the format prescribed for employment in Central Government institutions. It must be issued by a Revenue Officer not below the rank of Tahsildar. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through a walk-in interview. If many candidates turn up, SCTIMST will first hold a qualifying written test for screening. Only those who pass it will be called for the interview. Written test marks, if a test is held, will not count towards the final ranking.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: This is a project post on DST-funded Project P.8261. The appointment is initially up to 31.03.2027 and is likely to be extended up to 11.05.2027. Place of work: Biomedical Technology Wing, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SCTIMST Project Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check that you meet the qualification and the age limit. Fill in the Recruitment Report Form and prepare your bio-data. Go to Biomedical Technology Wing, Satelmond Palace, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram-695 012 on 12 November 2026. Report by 09.30 AM. Anyone who arrives after 09.30 AM will not be considered for selection. Take the written test if one is held, and then attend the interview at 10.30 AM. Duly filled Recruitment Report Form Bio-data Original and self-attested copies of certificates proving age, qualifications and experience Valid Income and Asset certificate (EWS candidates) No Objection Certificate from your present employer (if you are already in service) No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What qualification do I need for the SCTIMST Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is B.Sc Chemistry / Physics.

faq.question: Q2. Can a UR candidate attend the interview?
faq.answer: The vacancy is for the EWS category. UR candidates will be considered only if no eligible EWS candidate is available.

faq.question: Q3. What time must I reach the venue?
faq.answer: Report by 09.30 AM on 12 November 2026. The interview starts at 10.30 AM, and late arrivals will not be considered.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: At the Biomedical Technology Wing, Satelmond Palace, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram-695 012.

faq.question: Q5. How long will the appointment last?
faq.answer: It runs initially up to 31 March 2027 and is likely to be extended up to 11 May 2027.

faq.question: Q6. Will there be a written test?
faq.answer: Only if many candidates turn up. The test is qualifying, and its marks do not count in the final ranking.

faq.question: Q7. What will the Project Assistant work on?
faq.answer: The fabrication and characterization of polymeric microneedles, for a DST-funded project on microneedle array patches for trans-dermal drug delivery.

faq.question: Q8. What certificate do EWS candidates need?
faq.answer: A valid Income and Asset certificate in the format for Central Government institutions, issued by a Revenue Officer not below the rank of Tahsildar.

faq.question: Q9. Is travel allowance paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid.
